study_summary: External AUCs of 0.877–0.886 exceeded CHA2DS2-VASc, with favorable calibration and risk stratification.
outcome_summary: External AUCs of 0.877–0.886 exceeded CHA2DS2-VASc, with favorable calibration and risk stratification.
limitations: Observed treatment responsiveness and decision curves do not establish that model-guided anticoagulant initiation improves outcomes or safely changes treatment thresholds.

research_problem: Can a physics-informed digital twin infer cerebral vascular regulation from limited measurements?
ai_method: CereBRLSIM combines physiological mechanisms with latent-state inference using experimental, simulated, and patient data.
study_summary: Personalization to six neurocritical-care patients distinguished pressure-flow phenotypes and improved blood-flow forecasting compared with machine-learning baselines.
outcome_summary: Personalization to six neurocritical-care patients distinguished pressure-flow phenotypes and improved blood-flow forecasting compared with machine-learning baselines.
limitations: The tiny clinical sample and partly simulated validation cannot establish reliable outcome prediction or benefit from personalized treatment targets.

research_problem: Can one pretrained model provide reusable representations across 3D MRI tasks?
ai_method: Decipher-MR combines self-supervised visual learning and report supervision, attaching lightweight task decoders to a frozen encoder.
study_summary: Training used 200,000 series from over 22,000 studies; evaluated classification, localization, demographic, and retrieval tasks improved over compared models.
outcome_summary: Training used 200,000 series from over 22,000 studies; evaluated classification, localization, demographic, and retrieval tasks improved over compared models.
limitations: MRI series and studies are not patient counts; results apply to the tested datasets rather than universal anatomical or clinical generalization.

research_problem: Can language-model reformulation improve mapping ambiguous biomedical mentions to standard concepts?
ai_method: A neural-symbolic agent expands abbreviations and clarifies descriptions before terminology linking.
study_summary: MedMentions, ST21pv, and MCN benchmarks improved Recall@1, including gains up to 24.8 points for zero-shot abbreviations; human raters supported most generated expansions.
outcome_summary: MedMentions, ST21pv, and MCN benchmarks improved Recall@1, including gains up to 24.8 points for zero-shot abbreviations; human raters supported most generated expansions.

ai_method: HoloTrauma 3X integrates multimodal triadic reasoning for robot-assisted reconstruction across institutional datasets.

ai_method: VMHG was benchmarked against general guardrails on 1,800 simulated clinician-labeled messages and 794 mental-health messages from NVIDIA Aegis.
study_summary: Sensitivity remained near 0.99 across datasets, but external specificity fell to 0.859, revealing a false-positive tradeoff.
outcome_summary: Sensitivity remained near 0.99 across datasets, but external specificity fell to 0.859, revealing a false-positive tradeoff.

research_problem: Can clinicians refine liver segmentation by selecting candidates instead of drawing corrections?
ai_method: UAIR generates uncertainty-informed segmentation alternatives and iteratively aligns outputs with user selections.

research_problem: Can a glioma vision-language model predict molecular status and draft MRI reports?
ai_method: Glio-LLaMA-Vision combines biomedical image-text pretraining with 1,001 institutional training patients and multiple internal/external cohorts.
study_summary: IDH prediction AUCs ranged from 0.85 to 0.95; neuroradiologists judged 91% of generated reports clinically acceptable, though report-text metrics declined externally.

research_problem: Can a single clinical language model handle several structured-record prediction tasks?
ai_method: A seven-billion-parameter LLaMA-based Hopkins model was fine-tuned using 42,160 patients and externally evaluated across three systems.

outcome_summary: Four tasks involving 1,329 external patients yielded mean ROC-AUC 0.84 and improved on zero-shot language-model baselines.

research_problem: Can language models predict complications after vertebral kyphoplasty?
ai_method: GPT-5 and DeepSeek R1 were compared with conventional models and surgeons using retrospective and prospective single-hospital data.
